reviews.name: Ana
reviews.body:
I really liked these flakes, they are very comfortable to use and work well in daily care. The skin after them is moisturised, soft and looks fresh.

They do not irritate and are gentle, so you can safely use them every day. They also work well as a quick skin refresh.

For me, a great option, especially if I don't want to use a classic tonic.

For normal and sensitive combination skin.

reviews.name: Claudi
reviews.body: Suchte ein Augenfeuchtigkeitspad und habe nicht richtig gelesen ABER bin total zufrieden. Nach der Reinigung mit der mitgelieferten Pinzette ein dünnes pad entnehmen und schon beginnt die Feuchtigkeit auf der Haut zu wirken. Tolles Produkt...

reviews.name: Mojama
reviews.body: These are brilliant best 1s ive tried, stay were they should dont slip like others do n you can actually see the diff afterwards

reviews.name: Jan
reviews.body: These are fab, skin feels lovely after using them, I keep them in the fridge if had a rubbish night sleep, helps with the puffiness.
Love this product and it’s great for oily skin types !

reviews.name: Helliejx
reviews.body: This genuinely makes you achieve that glass skin, really does nourish the skin and hydrate it. I have sensitive skin and it hasn’t caused any issues. Second time purchase and I think this will be a new staple for me

reviews.name: Jen
reviews.body: I find them a bit slimy.  They aren't unpleasant on the skin, I just can't seem to fit it into my routine.

reviews.name: Niky
reviews.body: I love these toning pads. Super convenient and hydrate my skin really well.

reviews.name: NikW
reviews.body: Great product. My skin looks much fresher and plumper. Fine lines are less visible.
